muzzle_handgun.note: place origin at weapon muzzle, rotate to aim

decor:crosswalk.note: one stripe; repeat every 18 world px across the road, tile along its length

decor:canopy.note: overhead roof; draw above actors with some alpha

tree:oak_s.note: centre on the trunk solid; scale so canopy diameter = 2*cr

tree:oak_m.note: centre on the trunk solid; scale so canopy diameter = 2*cr

tree:oak_l.note: centre on the trunk solid; scale so canopy diameter = 2*cr

structure:campfire.note: base only; overlay fx fire_* at the centre

structure:turret_head.note: rotate by structure.aim around pivot (world px in body rect)

fence:wood.note: h strip for horizontal fences, v strip for vertical; tile along length, scale thickness to rect

characterInfo.note: All character/zombie frames are drawn at ART_SCALE (2x) and facing +x, origin at the body center. Display at scale (1/ART_SCALE) * (entityRadius / designRadius); at the design radius that is 0.5. Baked key light is top-left with a drop shadow down-right (sprite space).

player.figureNote: figure drawn 1.3x the design radius inside the same 128 frame (to match zombie on-screen size); display at 0.5 as before, no extra leg scaling needed

legs.note: rotate legs to movement direction, torso to aim

player.handsNote: hand/offHand in WORLD px from the player center (facing +x). Place weapon_<id> at `hand` rotated by weaponAngle (rad) to follow reload/swing frames; torsoYaw is the torso rotation baked into that frame (armor_body/backpack overlays are drawn at yaw 0, rotate them by torsoYaw to match).

wallInfo.note: h strips tile along x, v strips along y. Scale the strip thickness to the wall thickness (16 exterior, 10 interior). Caps are square posts for corners/ends. Light is top-left: h strips are lit on their top edge, v strips on their left edge.

door.note: threshold+jambs drawn on the floor across the door gap
